parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return in a single request.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token to retrieve the next page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. In a subsequent request, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous response.

parameters.name: NodeType
parameters.description:
The node type. This parameter is required when you query the accounts of a PolarDB Search node.

- Search

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number. The value must be an integer that is greater than 0. The default value is 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values:

- 30

- 50

- 100

The default value is 30.
